protocol_variants.title: Pigment chromatography / chloroform
protocol_variants.sample_policy: Independent protocol; do not concatenate with other variants. Within this protocol preserve each named sample; new aliquots/trials need separate state tracks and reference images.

procedure_steps.instruction: Prepare a leaf/flower extract with a small amount of methanol or acetone; filter.
procedure_steps.observation: Pigments are extracted; solvent quantity is not stated.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Use 4 by 17 cm paper with a baseline 3 cm above the lower end; apply and dry extract spots.
procedure_steps.observation: The sample spot remains above the mobile phase.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Prepare mobile phase from 19 mL petroleum ether (60-80 degrees C boiling fraction) and 1 mL chloroform; develop to about two-thirds paper length and mark the solvent front.
procedure_steps.observation: Separate pigment bands permit measured Rf calculation.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.
